_note: The guider service for T1's FAU (docs/guider.md), on the computer the FAU camera is plugged into:
Hardware-shaped but locked: allow_hardware is false, so nothing is opened until it is true AND --hardware is given,
which needs JDE's approval (docs/guider.md, Commissioning). Addresses are 127.0.0.1 placeholders.
From minerva-control (sites/minerva/README.md has the table): fau_t1.ini -- ZWO ASI174 (the file's
MANUFACTURER = SBIG is stale), 0.265 arcsec/px, the fiber at (949, 617) (backlit LED 2018-05-31; 0-based
pixels of the legacy FITS frame: confirm with POST /locate before trusting it), legacy loop gains
(Loop_params KPx/KIx, Deadband). T1 has no tip/tilt: the mount guides alone (legacy fauguide).
The FAU is on M3 port 2 (telescope_1.ini [PORT] FAU); 'port' names the calibration, not the port number.
_legacy_seed_calibrations: the mount's matrix from the plate scale at PA 0 (legacy derotates the FAU to PA 0).
It is a starting point to compare with POST /calibrate {"device": "mount"}; it is NOT loaded (keys
starting with _ are ignored). Copy it to 'calibrations' only to guide before a measured calibration exists.
name: t1-guider
